parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id
parameters.description: Unique company identifier associated with the Procore User Account.

post.description: Create a Bid Form for a Bid Package. A bid form is needed to submit a bid, since the bid will be made against the bid form.

lock_unit_fields_base_bid.description: Lock unit fields for all base bid items. Must be sent explicitly (no inheritance from bid package). Defaults to false if not provided.

lock_quantity_fields_base_bid.description: Lock quantity fields for all base bid items. Must be sent explicitly (no inheritance from bid package). Defaults to false if not provided.

lock_unit_fields_alternates.description: Lock unit fields for all alternate items. Must be sent explicitly (no inheritance from bid package). Defaults to false if not provided.

lock_quantity_fields_alternates.description: Lock quantity fields for all alternate items. Must be sent explicitly (no inheritance from bid package). Defaults to false if not provided.

header.description: Whether the item is a header or not

content_position.description: Position of this item in the unified ordering of its parent section's content, where bid form items and sub sections share a single 1-based sequence. Optional; when provided for any child of a section it must be provided for all of them, and the values must form a unique, gapless 1, 2, 3, ... sequence per section.

subject.example: Is the insurance of tools included in the Bid?

item_type.description: Bid Form Items can be of various types. This property does determine which one is used.

response_type.description: Bid Form Items can have various response types. This property determines which one is used.

x-changelog.description: Versioned the endpoint since we added a new required field called `response_type` to the payload.
Added a new optional field called `sub_sections` to the payload. Added `sub_sections` to the response

Added proposal_id to the payload and response of the endpoint to represent the proposal/estimate in the Estimating tool.
This is to support the integration between the Bidding and Estimating tools.

Added layer_id to the payload and response of bid form items to represent the layer in the Estimating tool.
This is to support the integration between the Bidding and Estimating tools.

x-changelog.summary: Added lock fields for unit and quantity
x-changelog.description:
Added 4 new lock fields to bid forms: lock_unit_fields_base_bid, lock_quantity_fields_base_bid,
lock_unit_fields_alternates, and lock_quantity_fields_alternates. These fields allow solicitors
to lock unit and quantity fields for bidders at the form level. Fields must be sent explicitly
when creating a bid form (no automatic inheritance from bid package). Defaults to false if not provided.

x-changelog.summary: Added locked_quantity and locked_unit_of_measure fields for bid form items
x-changelog.description:
Added locked_quantity and locked_unit_of_measure fields to the payload and response of bid form items.
These fields allow locking quantity and unit of measure values that cannot be changed by bidders.

x-changelog.summary: Added optional content_position field to bid form items and sub sections
x-changelog.description:
Bid form create and bulk-create requests now accept an optional `content_position`
integer on each bid form item and sub section, and it is returned in bid form
responses. The field places items and sub sections in a single unified 1-based
ordering within their parent section. When provided for any child of a section it
must be provided for all of them, and the values must form a unique, gapless
sequence (1, 2, 3, ...). Null when the unified ordering has not been assigned.

x-changelog.summary: Added optional content_position field to bid form items and sub sections
x-changelog.description:
Bid form update requests now accept an optional `content_position` integer on each
bid form item and sub section, and it is returned in bid form responses. The field
places items and sub sections in a single unified 1-based ordering within their
parent section. When provided for any child of a section it must be provided for
all of them, and the merged values (submitted children plus any omitted persisted
siblings) must form a unique, gapless sequence (1, 2, 3, ...) per section.
